verdict.rationale: Bolt's docs describe a direct Stripe integration for payments and subscriptions. Server-side functions are available through Supabase edge functions, which can be selected during project creation. The open-source repo also says Bolt can run Node.js servers and interact with third-party APIs. Missing for 10: any evidence of an email-sending integration (only email sign-up auth is documented), in-depth docs on building server functions natively rather than through Supabase, and independent hands-on corroboration of the payment and server-function workflows.
